## Problem / motivation

What user problem does this solve? Who benefits?

## Proposed solution

What you'd like to happen. UI sketches welcome.

## Alternatives considered

Other approaches you thought about and why you didn't pick them.

## Spec impact

Which spec file(s) would this change?

- [ ] `specs/specs.md` (vision/scope)
- [ ] `specs/architecture.md`
- [ ] `specs/data-model.md`
- [ ] `specs/ui.md`
- [ ] `specs/ux-states.md`
- [ ] `specs/ai.md`
- [ ] `specs/copilot.md`
- [ ] No spec change needed

## Additional context

Links, screenshots, related issues.
